title: A held INTERACT on a depleted or missing node ends and the gatherer is re-decided
summary: An INTERACT on a node that is missing or out of charges was held as a successful no-op for hundreds of ticks; it now fails with a typed reason that ends the task so the brain re-decides, with tests, TOWN-197, divergence 2.84, Bible 03 text, and the pinned all-gatherer effect reported.
